step1_analysis.description: This circuit is a simplified linear equivalent model, likely representing the input impedance or a sub-section of the cross-coupled pair / degeneration network used in a high-frequency LC VCO. It consists of RC networks and current sources to model the effective capacitance and losses.

paper_reference.title: High-Frequency LC VCO Design Using Capacitive Degeneration

sky130_expected.reasoning: Based on the paper's reported capacitance values for the degeneration cell.
